Scenario fixture: meta-redirect-immediate

01 — CANTTELL: the page sends the visitor to another address after 5 seconds

Whole-document check: one outcome per page. RGAA 13.1.2 wants a meta redirect to be immediate, unless it leaves an obsolete address, which only a person can tell. The immediate redirect (pass) and the refresh without a URL (notApplicable) are covered by this rule's inline tests.
